1127.unvetted: original not online and the editor's gloss is partial: Kirchhoff's list in Dittmar/Beitraege (IA beitrgezurgesch00dittgoog, full OCR searched) at no. 31 (2 Mar 1631) says only that from an unsigned letter 'grosstentheils in Ziffern' the Saxon marriage project emerges, i.e. the editor read the sense somehow; no. 33 (28 Mar) is 'leider nicht aufgeloest'. Riksarkivet original (Stockholm, Magdeburg letters to Gustavus Adolphus) not located online; known.py hits only the 1126/1127 rows and a Falkenberg key at VALA 02038 (different person); web search on Falkenberg cipher 1631 found nothing. Whether the editor or a contemporary decipherment accompanies the original is unknown; needs the Riksarkivet leaf.

1128.unvetted: original not located online: Klinckowstroem, Le comte de Fersen (IA lecomtedefersen01klingoog, OCR read) p.156 note says the postscript of the Empress is added to Gustavus III's 'lettre en chiffre (non dechiffree)' to Fersen of 28 Feb 1792, and the editor's other cipher letters carry Fersen's own marginal decipherments, so this one may still exist undeciphered in the Fersen papers (Stafsund, now Riksarkivet). No repository reference, no scan; known.py gives only the lead's own rows and the unrelated duben1764 target. Web search (Gustav III Fersen 28 fevrier 1792 chiffre) found nothing on a decipherment. Needs Riksarkivet Fersen collection finding aid and image.
